text: 现场直击｜上海旅游节花车抢先看，文商旅体展联动促消费 第37届上海旅游节将通过21辆主题花车巡游、专属 City Walk 精品路线、文旅联票及跨省分会场等多元举措，全面展现城市风貌并联动文商旅体展业态以拉动消费。
text_en: Live from the scene | Shanghai Tourism Festival floats preview: cultural, commercial, tourism, sports and exhibition linkages to boost consumption The 37th Shanghai Tourism Festival will showcase the city's风貌 through 21 themed float parades, exclusive City Walk routes, cultural-tourism combo tickets and cross-province sub-venues, linking cultural, commercial, tourism, sports and exhibition sectors to drive consumption.
